items.title: Graphs and Charts for Presenting Results

source_refs.note: 'Graphs and Charts for Presenting Results' under topic 7.5, as printed (PDF 101, printed 97).

blocks.text: Graphs and charts are commonly used tools for presenting results in hypothesis testing. Bar charts are useful for comparing categories or groups. Line graphs show trends and changes over time. Pie charts represent proportions and percentages effectively. Scatter plots display relationships between two variables. These visual tools make results more attractive, clear, and easier to interpret (as shown in Figure 7.2).
